sources.license_basis: The ordinance text (WHEREAS/ORDAINS/exhibit code language) is an edict of government — a legally operative enactment — and is public domain under the government-edicts doctrine (Banks v. Manchester, 1888; reaffirmed Georgia v. Public.Resource.Org, 2020) regardless of the enacting jurisdiction. The attached staff-report memo is Metro staff's own factual account of the ordinance's purpose and effect, authored as part of the public legislative record; reproduced here only as a small excerpt for research/critique (annotation-guideline development and an automated-reading validation study), not republished in full or for any commercial purpose.
sources.note: This PDF's staff-report page suffered silent word/phrase dropout during extraction (not just the interleaved-character corruption the clause filter screens for — whole words missing with no distinguishing signature, e.g. 'regarding income tax information / ormation may be provided' mid-sentence). Excluded from texts/staff-report/ entirely rather than left for the per-clause filter to catch, since it can't reliably catch a silent dropout. Kept for the ordinance genre only, where the clean WHEREAS/ORDAINS preamble is unaffected. See excluded/metro-ord-24-1514-staffreport.txt.excluded.
